metaDescription: Order custom gray dog tags for your team or event. Durable, printed with your logo. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gray dog tags offer a subtle, modern alternative to traditional silver or stainless steel. Perfect for corporate team IDs, event badges, or pet identification, these tags provide a neutral backdrop that makes your logo or text stand out. Choose from brushed or matte finishes and decorate with full-color digital printing or laser engraving for lasting clarity. Ideal for safety managers and HR directors needing professional, low-profile identification.
heroAltText: Custom gray dog tags with engraved logo on brushed metal surface, ideal for corporate ID and pet tags
